unit.why: A biographical note on R. Avraham Yehoshua Heschel (the Apter Rav) that establishes his standing as a scholar by quoting R. Moshe Teitelbaum's responsum in Heshiv Moshe. The quoted passage mentions a Shabbat visit and a question about a shochet only as citation evidence, with no narrated plot.
